historical_work: Explicit baseline; this is a continuation trial, not five cards from scratch.

cards.name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
cards.oracle_text:
Menace
When Siegfried enters, mill three cards. Then put X +1/+1 counters on Siegfried, where X is twice the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
acceptance: Use ExecuteEffectSequence, not only the private counter executor: mill three then apply twice own graveyard creature count.
Zero creature cards gives zero counters; two gives four; include preexisting own graveyard creatures.
Exclude opponent graveyard and noncreatures.
Unknown count specification must not invent one counter.
Static explicit positive counters and omitted static amount retain expected behavior.
Freshly parsed and converted Siegfried retains menace: one blocker is insufficient; two legal blockers are accepted.

cards.name: Sigil of Sleep
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to a player, return target creature that player controls to its owner's hand.
acceptance: Combat and noncombat damage from enchanted creature trigger exactly once for actual positive damage.
Prevented damage and unrelated life loss do not trigger.
Creature damage does not trigger this player-damage ability.
Targets belong to actually damaged player, even if that player is also aura controller.
Stolen creature returns to its owner; controller changes or other target illegality before resolution are rechecked.
Combat-only effects, including monarch, remain combat-only.
No duplicate emission across combat and generic damage paths.

cards.name: Skittering Cicada
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
You may cast colorless spells as though they had flash.
Whenever you cast a colorless spell, until end of turn, this creature gains trample and gets +X/+X, where X is that spell's mana value.
acceptance: Actual triggered sequence grants trample and +4/+4 from a four-mana-value colorless spell.
Zero mana value gives +0/+0 and still grants trample.
Both bonuses expire correctly at end of turn; repeated triggers stack.
Existing referent_spell_mana_value +X/+0 remains asymmetric.
Event source remains usable after triggering spell leaves stack; test X in casting context.
Fresh parsed card triggers only for required colorless casts and preserves its other abilities.
All three abilities work: Cicada itself has flash, controller may cast colorless spells with flash timing, and only colorless spell casts produce its temporary pump/trample trigger.

cards.name: Rakdos Roustabout
cards.reuse: Reuse recipient_from=attacked_defender; generated alias absence does not establish a runtime gap.
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
acceptance: Fresh parse, convert and trigger from actual block declaration against player and planeswalker.
Multiple blockers produce the correct trigger count.
Check removal from combat/source leaving battlefield and last-known attacked recipient against card wording.
Retain all other card abilities and pass full card gates.

cards.name: Sea God's Scorn
cards.reuse: Existing creature_or_enchantment filtering, owner-hand bounce and integrated target count bounds are reusable; old Engine evidence matched unrelated functions.
cards.oracle_text: Return up to three target creatures and/or enchantments to their owners' hands.
acceptance: Fresh parse and convert each actual card, then cast with 0,1,3 legal distinct targets successfully.
Reject 4 targets and duplicate selection; illegal creature types remain rejected.
Rejected casts leave hand, mana and stack unchanged.
Resolve exactly chosen targets; partial/all-invalid targets and zero-target resolution remain correct.
Exercise alternate casting paths that consume the same requirement.
Existing required-one spells still reject zero; union bounce returns to owner, not controller.
